candidates.summary: Open builds the summary segment from indices into PeekLine's padded line without subtracting segment.Padding, so a :::details entered through a tab loses the summary's first bytes and reads past the line, and past the page's end panics RenderRealm
candidates.failure_scenario: A realm page whose list item continues on a tab-indented line ('- item\n\t:::details Summary text\n\tbody'), or a '>\t:::details' line in a blockquote or alert, renders the summary as 'mmary text': PeekLine prepends Padding spaces that Open counts into pos and then adds to segment.Start, so the segment is shifted Padding bytes right. When that line ends the page and the source has cap == len (GetMarkdownView's []byte(mdContent) on a 64-byte page), the segment ends past the buffer and RenderRealm panics 'slice bounds out of range [:66] with capacity 64', so the page fails to render for every viewer. goldmark's own atx heading subtracts segment.Padding (parser/atx_heading.go:105-106). Catalog class: Error & panic handling. At the merge base the same input renders as plain text.
candidates.verify_by: cp tests/solo-finder-tab-padding-render_test.go gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/solo_tab_padding_render_test.go && go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/ -run TestSoloRenderRealmTabDetails -v (head: mid_page 'mmary text', page_end_64 panic; base via -overlay: PASS); then subtract segment.Padding at ext_details.go:193-194 and rerun tests/solo-finder-tab-padding_test.go: PASS
